name: VSTECS
recent: VSTECS 于 2026 年 11 月 18 日公布季度业绩，并宣派每股 0.93 仙的首次中期股息。公司于 10 月 28 日完成出售 ISATEC 40% 股权，套现约 RM48.75 百万。执行董事 Foo Lek Choong 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报买卖公司股份。
notable: 完成出售 ISATEC 40% 股权予 Skyform Pte Ltd，现金代价约 RM48.75 百万。
宣派首次单层中期股息每股 0.93 仙。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
risks: 执行董事 Foo Lek Choong 在闭门期及非闭门期多次申报买卖公司股份。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM1,078.2 百万，环比增长 3.0%，同比增长 31.7%；净利为 RM30.3 百万，环比增长 32.4%，同比增长 50.3%；净利率为 2.8%，高于上一季度的 2.2%。

recent_en: VSTECS announced its quarterly results on 18 November 2026 and declared a first interim dividend of 0.93 sen per share. The company completed the disposal of its 40% stake in ISATEC on 28 October for about RM48.75 million. Executive Director Foo Lek Choong filed multiple notices of share dealings between October and November.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of a 40% stake in ISATEC to Skyform Pte Ltd for a cash consideration of about RM48.75 million.
Declared a first single-tier interim dividend of 0.93 sen per share.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director Foo Lek Choong filed multiple notices of share dealings during and outside the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,078.2 million, up 3.0% QoQ and 31.7% YoY; net income was RM30.3 million, up 32.4% QoQ and 50.3% YoY; net margin was 2.8%, higher than 2.2% in the previous quarter.
